source_name: Eastern Highlands field sites (Chimanimani, Mutare, Nyanga)
collection_method: MinION sequencing + Illumina + LC-MS extracts + portable environmental sensors
permission_status: NBA bioprospecting permit — Phase I application; community council endorsement obtained per ward
known_limitations: Montane access is seasonal and roads become impassable in heavy rain. Endemic species are patchily distributed, so ecozone quota may be met with uneven taxonomic spread. Sites are closer to research institutions than the other two zones, which is itself a sampling bias.
fallback_source: Nyanga and Mutare communal wards substitute for any Chimanimani site made inaccessible by weather or road; Herbarium vouchers substitute for field identification.

collection_method: MinION sequencing + Illumina + LC-MS extracts + portable environmental sensors
permission_status: ZimParks research access — in negotiation. Phase I collection is anchored on adjacent communal land where community council endorsement is the operative permission.
known_limitations: Protected-area access is not confirmed and is a Phase I gate, not an assumption. The thermophilic soil and actinomycete chemistry sought is not confined to the park boundary, but a communal-land-only sample under-represents undisturbed lowveld habitat and this must be disclosed in any analysis. Extreme heat shortens the safe interval between collection and preservation.
fallback_source: Communal lowveld wards in Chiredzi and Chipinge substitute entirely for Gonarezhou National Park. ADOPTED AS PRIMARY: the park access permit is not secured, so Phase I is anchored on communal land.

collection_method: MinION sequencing + Illumina + LC-MS extracts + portable environmental sensors
permission_status: District Environmental Officer permits — Phase I; community council endorsement per ward
known_limitations: Wet-season collection window overlaps peak farming season, reducing knowledge-holder availability. Termite-mound sampling is destructive to the mound and is limited by agreement to a small number per site. Largest biome by area but sampled with the smallest per-hectare intensity.
fallback_source: Gokwe and Hwange are interchangeable within the Zvishavane stratum; Midlands communal woodland is the third option.

collection_method: Structured interviews in Shona and Ndebele by trained community liaisons; consented audio recording; verbatim transcription; bilingual second-reviewer validation
permission_status: FPIC per individual holder AND community council endorsement obtained before any interview
known_limitations: Records only what consenting holders in participating communities chose to share, so the corpus is not representative of Zimbabwe as a whole. Knowledge classified sacred is never requested and is therefore absent by design, not by omission. Older holders are less available during farming season. Shona-speaking communities are more accessible than Ndebele-speaking ones; a 30% Ndebele floor is enforced to counter this.
fallback_source: No fallback exists and none is sought. Knowledge holders cannot be substituted for one another; if a council declines, that district is simply not represented and the gap is disclosed.

collection_method: Digitisation of existing accessions plus provenance mapping and taxonomic cross-referencing of newly collected voucher specimens
known_limitations: Historical accessions carry collection metadata of variable quality and pre-date modern coordinate standards. Colonial-era collection is geographically skewed toward accessible and settler-occupied areas. Determinations follow the taxonomy of their era and may need revision.
fallback_source: Sequence-confirmed identification (rbcL/matK) substitutes where the Herbarium backlog delays a voucher determination.

collection_method: LC-MS analysis of preserved field extracts; instrument calibration logged per batch
permission_status: SIRDC institutional access — Prof T. Mushiri, Director. MOU in preparation. SIRDC is the designated primary data steward.
known_limitations: Single-instrument dataset, so instrument-specific retention-time and intensity bias cannot be separated from biological signal by comparison. Untargeted LC-MS confidently identifies only a minority of detected features; most remain MSI level 3-4. Solvent choice bounds which chemical space is observable at all.
fallback_source: University of Zimbabwe LC-MS, or an accredited South African facility under an executed transfer agreement, substitutes if the SIRDC instrument is unavailable.

source_name: Holder-directed sites outside the Phase I ecozones (opportunistic)
collection_method: Portable environmental sensors + silica-gel preservation; sequencing and LC-MS scheduled on return to SIRDC
permission_status: District Environmental Officer permit under the standing NBA authorisation; community council endorsement per ward, obtained at the point of collection
known_limitations: Collection here follows a knowledge holder rather than the sampling frame, so these sites are not a stratum and carry no quota. They are recorded with ecozone 'Other' and a free-text locality_description because no controlled vocabulary describes them. Site selection is therefore convenience-driven and cannot support any claim of representativeness; validator check V24 reports the out-of-frame share each batch so drift away from the three named zones is visible rather than absorbed silently.
fallback_source: None. These sites exist only because a holder led the team to them and are not substitutable.
